title: Pushing CPU Speech Synthesis to the Wall: Extreme Inference Tuning under Serverless Architecture and Billing
abstract: arXiv:2610.00063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instance-billed serverless platforms charge for CPU and memory over the lifetime of a warm instance, making idle inference state a direct serving cost. We present billing-aware neural text-to-speech (TTS) serving on serverless CPUs, optimizing CPU-seconds and GB-seconds rather than throughput or latency alone. Conventional runtimes are poorly suited to this setting: per-request parallelism causes CPU contention under concurrency, while warm instances retain gigabytes of billable inference and page-cache state.   We address these costs with request-sized concurrent inference, which bounds per-request CPU parallelism, and a reclaimable instance lifecycle, which releases inference state and page-cache memory after idle periods while retaining the server process and compile cache. On Kokoro-82M, our system achieves 2.71 audio-seconds per CPU-second versus 0.89 with ONNX Runtime defaults and reduces cost per audio-hour from $0.0631 with PyT

translated_title: 将CPU语音合成推向极限：无服务器架构与计费模式下的极致推理调优
translated_abstract: 按实例计费的无服务器平台会在热实例的整个存续期内对CPU和内存进行收费，这使得空闲状态下的推理状态成为直接的服务成本。我们提出了在无服务器CPU上运行的计费感知神经文本转语音（TTS）服务系统，其优化目标是CPU秒数和GB秒数，而不仅仅是吞吐量或延迟。传统运行时环境并不适合这一场景：每请求并行化在并发情况下会导致CPU争用，而热实例则会保留数GB的可计费推理状态和页面缓存内存。我们通过“请求级规模的并发推理”来限制每请求的CPU并行度，并通过“可回收的实例生命周期”在空闲期后释放推理状态和页面缓存内存，同时保留服务器进程和编译缓存，从而解决上述成本问题。在Kokoro-82M模型上，我们的系统实现了每CPU秒生成2.71音频秒的性能（相比之下ONNX Runtime默认设置仅为0.89），并将每音频小时的成本从PyTorch的0.0631美元显著降低。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种计费感知的无服务器CPU语音合成服务系统，通过请求级并发推理和可回收实例生命周期两项核心技术，实现了每CPU秒2.71音频秒的生成效率（相比ONNX Runtime默认的0.89提升约3倍），大幅降低了按实例计费模式下的TTS服务成本。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a billing-aware serverless CPU TTS serving system that, through request-sized concurrent inference and a reclaimable instance lifecycle, achieves 2.71 audio-seconds per CPU-second (about 3x better than ONNX Runtime defaults) and dramatically reduces serving costs under instance-based billing.
